bundle.shortDescription: Password-protected encrypted vaults for USB drives
bundle.longDescription: VaultDrive encrypts a folder into a single portable .vault file using XChaCha20-Poly1305 with an Argon2id-derived key. The vault opens on any computer with the password, and on none without it. VaultDrive cannot recover a forgotten password: there is no master password and no backdoor.
